question: Will SpaceX lift the limits, yes or no?

lines.text: Ukraine says SpaceX has restricted some Starlink services over Ukraine, without warning.
Presidential adviser Serhiy Beskrestnov says it hit overnight and disrupted several drone missions.
He says the military version stopped working above 160 kilometres an hour.
In his words, Ukraine's forces did not receive a warning about this limitation.

scene.quote: did not receive a warning about this limitation

lines.text: Ukraine's Seventh Rapid Reaction Corps, in the southeast, told Reuters the link could drop for 10 to 20 seconds.
It says that happened at just 110 to 120 kilometres an hour, and some missions were cancelled.
Starlink guides Ukraine's longer-range drone strikes in the occupied south and east.
Poland says it pays for Kyiv's Starlink subscription.
Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski asked Elon Musk on X if he is playing politics with his products again.

scene.quote: are you playing politics with your products again?

lines.text: He added: as your European customers, we are watching you.

scene.quote: As your European customers, we are watching you

lines.text: Reuters says SpaceX did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
It also says the reason for the limit is not clear.
Will SpaceX lift the limits, yes or no?
